title: WCM_SWB_Irri: field-scale irrigation estimation with a soil water balance model coupled to the Water Cloud Model
description:
Per-field Bayesian (PyMC) calibration of a two-layer soil water balance model coupled to the Water Cloud Model against Sentinel-1 backscatter and Sentinel-2 NDVI, to estimate irrigation from satellite data without in-situ measurements. Includes the scripts that download the input data (Sentinel-1/2 via Google Earth Engine, SoilGrids, MERIDA) and notebooks to analyse the results.

This software was developed for the paper: Natali, M., Modanesi, S., De Santis, D., De Lannoy, G., Steele-Dunne, S., Flammini, A., Domeneghetti, A., Massari, C. (2026). Field-scale irrigation estimation using Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data within a soil water balance model coupled to the Water Cloud Model. Remote Sensing of Environment, 346, 115639. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2026.115639. Please cite both this software and the paper.
notes: When using this software, please cite it together with the paper: Natali et al. (2026), Remote Sensing of Environment, 346, 115639, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2026.115639.
